title: Changelist: June 2025 - Planning Mode & The Browser
description: Windsurf introduced two major new surfaces: Planning Mode for collaborating with Cascade on long-term goals with persistent plan.md files, and The Browser with native AI integration and deep flow awareness. June was described as 'a big step forward in extending Windsurf's reach.'

community_feedback.quote: Being able to one shot tasks far more often than without planning mode
Planning mode takes 60+ seconds to update a single sentence
Users discussing how Planning Mode helped save time and improve sanity by maintaining persistent plans for projects

title: GitHub Copilot in VS Code June Release (v1.102)
description: The June 2025 release of Visual Studio Code (v1.102) includes GitHub Copilot updates with Model Context Protocol (MCP) features becoming available and various improvements to the Copilot experience. Release became available on July 9, 2025.

community_feedback.quote: Reddit discussion about VS Code June 2025 version 1.102 and GitHub Copilot Chat extension

title: Cursor 1.0 - BugBot, Background Agent & One-Click MCP Installation
description: Cursor released version 1.0, their first stable major release. Key features include BugBot for automatic code review and bug fixing, Background Agent now available to all users, Memories feature for project-level learning, One-Click MCP setup with OAuth support, and deep Jupyter Notebook integration.

community_feedback.quote: 613 points and 468 comments on Hacker News, indicating strong community engagement with this release
Multiple sources calling it 'a new era for AI-powered development tools'
Cursor reached $100 million ARR in June 2025, making it one of the fastest software products to achieve this milestone
Claims that half of Cursor 1.0 was 'playing catch up to Windsurf' - Memories, Jupyter Notebooks, and BugBot were already available in Windsurf

title: Enhanced MCP Support and Streamlined Editing
description: Continue released v1.0.12 for VS Code and v1.0.21 for JetBrains with enhanced Model Context Protocol (MCP) support including SSE and Streamable HTTP transports for remote hosting, resource templates support, streamlined edit mode, and cancelable apply streaming.

title: Gemini CLI Launch - Open-Source AI for Terminals
description: Google launched Gemini CLI on June 25, 2025 as an open-source command-line interface that brings Gemini AI capabilities directly into terminal environments. Multiple Medium articles covered the launch, describing it as a tool that 'changes everything for developers' and transforms terminals into 'AI-powered super tools.'

community_feedback.quote: Described as turning terminals into 'AI-powered super tools'

title: Aider v0.85.0 - Responses API Models & Gemini 2.5 Support
description: Aider v0.85.0 released on June 27, 2025 with support for Responses API models including o1-pro and o3-pro, new Gemini 2.5 Pro models support, and updated costs for o3 models. Gemini 2.5 Pro achieved SOTA on the aider polyglot coding leaderboard with 73% score.

community_feedback.quote: Gemini 2.5 Pro set the SOTA (State of the Art) on the aider polyglot coding leaderboard with a score of 73%, well ahead of thinking/reasoning models
